after.zh: 图块数 = 像素数 ÷ P²，注意力的计算量跟着图块数涨；图块大了，每块又粗得只能认出大结构。ViT 把 224×224 的图切成 16×16 的图块，正好是 196 个：在计算量和细节之间取的一个折中。
after.en: The number of patches is the number of pixels ÷ P², and the cost of attention grows with it; but bigger patches are too coarse to see anything but large structure. ViT cuts a 224×224 image into 16×16 patches, exactly 196 of them: a compromise between cost and detail.

t.zh: 注意力里，每一格都要把所有图块加一遍。图块切得越小，图块就越多，要算的也越多。
t.en: In attention, every cell adds up over all the patches. The smaller the patches, the more of them there are, and the more there is to compute.

t.zh: <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref>多了一个设置：图块边长 P，可以是 2、4 或 8。
t.en: <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref> has gained a setting: the patch size P, which can be 2, 4 or 8.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：图案变成了 8×8 的，一张图四个，还是补全对角；计算量有上限。
t.en: Your task in this level: the patterns are now 8×8, four to a picture, and it is mending across the diagonal again; the cost has a limit.

caption.zh: 第一组：左上角的图案缺了几块
caption.en: Set 1: the top-left pattern is missing a few blocks

brief.zh: 还是补全对角，这次图案是 8×8 的，一张图四个。计算量不能超过 10。
brief.en: Mending across the diagonal again, this time with 8×8 patterns, four to a picture. The cost must not exceed 10.

hint.zh: 注意力的每一格都要把所有图块加一遍。图块越大，图块越少。
hint.en: Each cell of attention adds up over every patch. The bigger the patches, the fewer there are.
